initiatives.name: OC Protests
initiatives.description: Orange County group started in June 2020 by young Black women to publicize protests, later running mutual aid, political education and legal advocacy. Describes itself as femme-led and rooted in abolition.

initiatives.name: OC Rapid Response Network
initiatives.description: Coalition of Orange County, California organizations running an ICE-sighting and detention hotline, with know-your-rights guides, free immigration consultations and DACA renewal help.

initiatives.name: Chicanxs Unidxs
initiatives.description: Community organization in Orange County, California, founded in 2006. Works on policing, gang injunctions and gentrification, and runs a legal clinic.

initiatives.name: Abolition Now OC
initiatives.description: We're an abolitionist collective that provides mutual aid support to people released from OC jails.

initiatives.name: 714 Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: We are proud to be able to make naloxone available to our neighbors who have friends and loved ones who are at risk of opioid related emergencies.
